archetypes.name: White-Blue Blink
archetypes.plan: Build around Spire Patrol: Reuse enter-the-battlefield abilities with blink and bounce while flyers create a tempo-driven clock.

archetypes.name: Blue-Black Artifacts
archetypes.plan: Build around Tezzeret's Touch: Accumulate artifacts and improvise-style synergies while interaction protects the value generated by each artifact.

archetypes.name: Black-Red Artifacts
archetypes.plan: Build around Weldfast Engineer: Keep artifacts entering and leaving the battlefield so artifact payoffs turn ordinary material into damage and value.

archetypes.name: Red-Green Power
archetypes.plan: Build around Outland Boar: Develop high-power creatures, trigger rewards for four-power threats, and use combat tricks to win forced blocks.

archetypes.name: Green-White Revolt
archetypes.plan: Build around Renegade Rallier: Enable revolt with sacrifice, bounce, or combat trades, then cast revolt payoffs after a permanent leaves.

archetypes.name: White-Black Revolt
archetypes.plan: Build around Hidden Stockpile: Trigger revolt through sacrifice or combat, then deploy efficient revolt creatures while grinding with recursion.

archetypes.name: Blue-Red Artifacts
archetypes.plan: Build around Maverick Thopterist: Combine cheap artifacts with cards that trigger from casting or sacrificing them, then win through tempo and reach.

archetypes.name: Black-Green Counters
archetypes.plan: Build around Winding Constrictor: Distribute counters across durable creatures and use counter payoffs to dominate creature combat.

archetypes.name: Red-White Vehicles
archetypes.plan: Build around Renegade Wheelsmith: Crew efficient Vehicles with expendable creatures, clear blockers, and pressure through sorcery-speed creature defenses.

archetypes.name: Green-Blue Energy
archetypes.plan: Build around Rogue Refiner: Generate energy with efficient permanents, spend it on tempo or growth, and preserve enough for repeated activations.
